Many residents are university and college students and immigrants (there are many Saudis and Ethiopians, for example). It's incredibly convenient to shopping and services (3-5 minute walk to bus stops, the mall, to the grocery, library, to shops and restaurants and to the post office). We have a small wetlands park that is in the process of restoration next to the building if you enjoy bird watching. We have a lot of ducks and the park is also home to several elusive beavers. It's a good place to live but not a touristic location.
notes: There will be no escaping the affections of our cat. You must enjoy cats if you stay here. I may be renting out our other room when you're here.

It's incredibly convenient to shopping and services (3-5 minute walk to bus stops, the mall, to the grocery, library, to shops and restaurants and to the post office).
